svg.title: Micro Studio · winter solar study
svg.desc: Concept winter solar study for Micro Studio. A 20 degree sun altitude is shown against the south facade, roof overhang, glazing and the installed south-facing panels. The panel divisions match the canonical array count. It is a qualitative shading diagram; monthly energy estimates are published separately.
svg.text: South-facing section · sun altitude about 20° · overhang 0.6 m · qualitative shading only
Winter: low sun should reach the glazing; snow shedding and glare need review.
No energy production, overheating, daylight or glare result is calculated. Confirm with a whole-building energy and shading model.
Concept solar study · schematic · Containers Hamlet Design Lab · CC BY-SA 4.0
